items.title: Wilbert Tillman Interview, 1966-01-20
items.q: Oh, you know I played with him. Yeah. He had one of my first bands.

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. Let's see. That's interesting. Uh, did you play with the, uh, Onward Brass Band ever? The old Onward? Yeah, the old Onward. No. What about the Excelsior?
I didn't play with any of them. Uh, Old Man Allen? What about him? Oh, you know I played with him. Yeah. He had one of my first bands.
Tanner Island. Mm-hmm. What was your first brass band job? Do you remember?
